name: Real-time Respiratory Signal Prediction Benchmark (4D SBRT)
description: Evaluates and compares machine-learning methods for real-time respiratory signal prediction used in 4D stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT).
reputation: Niche clinical research benchmark with limited but focused adoption in radiotherapy signal-prediction studies.
notes: Non-LLM, small/specialized clinical dataset; sensitive to latency requirements and patient-privacy concerns; results can vary with preprocessing and sensor setup.
